answer_2.quote: In the domain of text summarisation, ROUGE is the most used metric for the evaluation of generated summaries. ... we implement the ROUGE metric ... Additionally, we include BERTScore (BeS) and BartScore (BaS) ... readability metrics, e.g. Flesch-Kincaid (FLK) and Coleman-Liau Index (CLI)

answer_4.quote: In order to obtain a more comprehensive evaluation of the generated summaries, we also incorporate human evaluation. ... We invite 3 qualified evaluators ... to rate 30 randomly sampled instances from the testset.
answer_4.guideline: annotators rated summaries on a Likert scale for fluency, readability, relevance, and informativeness
